Name: Jaaziah, Son of Merari
Summary: Son of Merari, father of Beno in the rest of the sons of Levi.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:26: Son of Merari, father of Beno in the rest of the sons of Levi.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jaaziah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
